server.description: Internet censorship data, Sentinel forecasts and agent relay tools; relay keys stay in a local file.

environmentVariables.description: Relay writes addressed to another agent (send, invite, task creation, every task update) are refused unless that agent's DID is listed here. A comma list of DIDs, or * for any agent (also allows broadcast and webhooks). Leave empty to keep them off.
environmentVariables.name: VOIDLY_MCP_RELAY_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow channel posts and creation, profile and capability changes, attestations, corroborations, and a chosen name in agent_register. Leave empty to keep them off.
environmentVariables.name: VOIDLY_MCP_RELAY_ALLOW_OPEN_WRITES

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow joining channels, answering invites, marking messages read, deleting messages, heartbeats and deleting capabilities. Leave empty to keep them off.
environmentVariables.name: VOIDLY_MCP_RELAY_ALLOW_STATE_CHANGES

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow relay-side memory writes (relay-readable; credential-shaped values are always refused). Leave empty to keep them off.
environmentVariables.name: VOIDLY_MCP_RELAY_ALLOW_MEMORY_WRITES

environmentVariables.description: Directory for the local relay credential files (default ~/.voidly/mcp-relay). Never put a relay key in client config.
environmentVariables.name: VOIDLY_MCP_RELAY_HOME

environmentVariables.description: Pin the relay identity the tools act as, when more than one is stored.
environmentVariables.name: VOIDLY_MCP_RELAY_DID

environmentVariables.description: Optional absolute path to the owner's approved, private creator setup JSON. Needed only for creator tools; keep the file user-owned with mode 0600 on Unix.

environmentVariables.description: Optional absolute path to the private original-operation journal for creator recovery. Keep this directory user-owned with mode 0700 on Unix.
environmentVariables.name: VOIDPAY_MCP_STATE_DIR

server.name: io.github.voidmobcom/voidmob-mcp
server.description: Mobile proxies, non-VoIP SMS verifications, dedicated numbers, and global eSIMs for AI agents.

environmentVariables.description: API key from https://dashboard.voidmob.com/developers/api-keys (vmk_live_...). Needed for real purchases; without it tools are listed but every call returns setup instructions.
environmentVariables.name: VOIDMOB_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to use offline mock data with a $500 play balance instead of the live API (no key needed, nothing is charged).
environmentVariables.name: VOIDMOB_SANDBOX

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to hide every tool that spends money or changes anything (searches and reads stay available).
environmentVariables.name: VOIDMOB_READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Refuse any single purchase, renewal or top-up whose max price is above this many US cents (e.g. 2500 = $25).
environmentVariables.name: VOIDMOB_MAX_ORDER_CENTS

environmentVariables.description: Spending limit in US cents for this server process (a per-session safety net, not an account limit); purchases that would exceed it, and turning on auto-renew, are refused.
environmentVariables.name: VOIDMOB_BUDGET_CENTS

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let the agent buy without asking first, within the limits. Needs VOIDMOB_BUDGET_CENTS or a daily limit on the API key; every limit still applies.
environmentVariables.name: VOIDMOB_AUTONOMOUS

environmentVariables.description: Comma list of tool groups to load: sms, numbers, esim, proxy (account, deposit, orders and geo tools are always on). Default: all.
environmentVariables.name: VOIDMOB_TOOLSETS

server.name: io.github.vojtisprime11/web-fetcher
server.description: Turns any web page into clean Markdown, page metadata and classified links for LLMs.

environmentVariables.description: Request timeout in milliseconds (1000-120000). Defaults to 15000.
environmentVariables.name: WEB_FETCHER_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Maximum bytes downloaded per response. Defaults to 5000000.
environmentVariables.name: WEB_FETCHER_MAX_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: User-Agent header sent with every request.
environmentVariables.name: WEB_FETCHER_USER_AGENT

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to allow fetching loopback and private network addresses. Disables the SSRF guard.
environmentVariables.name: WEB_FETCHER_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to enforce robots.txt before fetching.
environmentVariables.name: WEB_FETCHER_RESPECT_ROBOTS
